findings.claim: Meta redaction only recurses into arrays. A forbidden key inside a non-array value (stdClass) is JSON-encoded into the problem body. Nested lists of arrays are stripped; objects are not.
findings.repro: On vaulter.v1.__probe, a ProblemException with problemDetails() ['context' => (object) ['secret' => 'object-secret', 'ok' => 2], 'items' => [['token' => 'list-token-secret']]] returned 409 application/problem+json whose meta was {"items":[[],{"ok":1}],"context":{"secret":"object-secret","ok":2}}. list-token-secret was removed; object-secret was not.

findings.claim: The exception message is stripped only when problemDetails() uses the exact key errors. Any other case (Errors) is left in meta, and Errors is not on the forbidden-key list, so getMessage() and a path reach the body.
findings.repro: Same probe, problemDetails() ['Errors' => ['url' => ['[Vaulter] message-via-Errors-key path=/tmp/errors-secret']]] produced meta.Errors.url = ["[Vaulter] message-via-Errors-key path=/tmp/errors-secret"]. The exact key errors on BlockedOutboundUrlException::blockedAddress('metadata.google.internal','169.254.169.254') was rewritten to the lang detail and did not contain the host or 169.254.169.254.

findings.claim: prepareException turns an AuthorizationException that has a status into a plain HttpException before renderables run. classify() then emits http_<status> instead of 403 permission_denied. The denial message is not copied. A status-less AuthorizationException still becomes AccessDeniedHttpException and maps to permission_denied.
findings.repro: Response::deny('hidden-gate-403')->withStatus(403)->authorize() on vaulter.v1.__probe returned {"status":403,"code":"http_403","detail":null}. withStatus(404) returned {"status":404,"code":"http_404"}. hidden-gate-403 was absent from the body.
